llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render the tap target under `GestureHandlerRootView` and attach gestures with `GestureDetector gesture={...}` from `react-native-gesture-handler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses TapGestureHandler (legacy component) instead of GestureDetector with gesture={...} prop. GestureDetector is never imported or rendered.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define both gestures with `Gesture.Tap()` builders (`singleTap` and `doubleTap`) using current builder callbacks (`onEnd`) and MUST NOT use legacy `useAnimatedGestureHandler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No Gesture.Tap() builders used. Gestures are defined via TapGestureHandler components with onHandlerStateChange callbacks, not via Gesture.Tap().onEnd(...) builder pattern.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must call `scheduleOnRN(...)` inside tap `onEnd` success paths to update React state and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnJS`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: scheduleOnRN is never called anywhere in the submission. Tap callbacks use plain JS functions with console.log only, no React state updates bridged via scheduleOnRN.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must compose taps with `Gesture.Exclusive(doubleTap, singleTap)` so exclusivity is defined by RNGH composition APIs.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Gesture.Exclusive() is never used. Exclusivity is implemented via the legacy waitFor={doubleTapRef} ref prop on TapGestureHandler.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must configure tap-recognition windows via `Gesture.Tap().numberOfTaps(2).maxDelay(...)` for double tap and `Gesture.Tap().numberOfTaps(1)` for single tap, with explicit duration limits via `maxDuration(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No .numberOfTaps(), .maxDelay(), or .maxDuration() builder calls exist. The legacy numberOfTaps prop is used on TapGestureHandler components, but maxDelay and maxDuration are absent entirely.
